subject: Mid-cycle alignment: narrow scope proposals + runway commitment asks
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kira Lopez <kira.lopez@atlascloud.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle alignment: narrow scope proposals + runway commitment asks

Team and Kira —

Following our QBR prep run yesterday, I pulled together a compact re-scope that preserves the customer success metrics AtlasCloud needs while reducing cross-team work by ~35%. Attached is a one-pager and a dependency runbook. Key asks:

- Infra commit: 3x GPU slots in Dedicated pool for 6 weeks (autoscale disabled) to validate end-to-end latency at peak load.
- Data team: snapshot of AtlasCloud demo dataset and retention agreement (we need a consented sample by Oct 6).
- Security: quick SOC2 checklist signoff on token-redaction flow (target Oct 5).

Proposed scope (high level):
- Deliver the trimmed inference flow (embedding -> cached reranking -> lightweight prompt routing) by Oct 20.
- Hold advanced cache-sharding and cross-region routing for the Nov sprint.

Kira, does this reflect what you heard? If AtlasCloud can commit the demo dataset timeline, we can push the internal cutover date earlier.

Attachments: 20260929-proposed-scope-narrowing.pdf; runbook-deps-and-cutover.xlsx

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior PM, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kira Lopez <kira.lopez@atlascloud.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle alignment: narrow scope proposals + runway commitment asks

Nice, short and actionable — thanks. A few leadership steers:

- Tighten acceptance criteria: replace "improved latency" with exact P95 targets (service-level goal 180ms end-to-end for the demo workload).
- Risk window: we need a contingency plan if infra slot procurement slips by more than 5 business days. Add a fallback to a smaller model variant with cache-bumped warmup.
- Visibility: weekly 15-minute readout with ownership assigned (suggest Naomi to lead infra gating).

@Naomi, can you confirm capacity and the contingency feasibility? @Vanessa, please flag any exec concerns about pushing this forward in QBR pack.

-Markus
VP, Product Operations

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kira Lopez <kira.lopez@atlascloud.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle alignment: narrow scope proposals + runway commitment asks

Quick infra reality check:

- We can reserve 3x GPU slots in Dedicated for 6 weeks starting Oct 12 if AtlasCloud signs the demo support agreement by Oct 6 (procurement + legal gating).
- Contingency: we can stand up a 2x GPU test cluster on Oct 8 for early smoke tests, but it won't hit the P95 target — this is strictly to validate runbook and integration.
- Ops lead: I'll run the 15-minute weekly readouts on Mondays (first on Oct 12).

I'll attach the short runbook with the provisioning checklist to the drive link and update the timeline. Naomi

From: Kira Lopez <kira.lopez@atlascloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle alignment: narrow scope proposals + runway commitment asks

Thanks, Soojin — this aligns with our expectations. A few notes from AtlasCloud procurement/legal: 

- We can provide the demo dataset by Oct 5 if Redwood supplies a short DPA addendum and a hashing/pseudonymization checklist by EOD Sep 30.
- Procurement will approve the 6-week Dedicated reservation as a short-term pilot if we finalize SLA terms; they asked for a simple exhibit outlining rollback and data deletion steps.

I'll get our procurement lead to route the DPA addendum this afternoon. On the acceptance criteria: P95 180ms sounds reasonable for the smaller model path; we'll accept the contingency plan if you document the degraded-quality expectation in the runbook.

Kira Lopez
Head of Integrations
AtlasCloud

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Kira Lopez <kira.lopez@atlascloud.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle alignment: narrow scope proposals + runway commitment asks

Thanks all — quick synthesis and action items (for the QBR pack):

1) Acceptance criteria: P95 <= 180ms for demo workload on Dedicated (owners: Naomi / Ops).
2) Infra commitment: preliminary 2x GPU cluster for smoke tests on Oct 8; full 3x GPU Dedicated slot reserve starting Oct 12 pending DPA and procurement signature (owners: Naomi / AtlasCloud procurement).
3) Data: AtlasCloud to deliver consented sample by Oct 5; Redwood to provide DPA addendum and hashing checklist (owner: Soojin / Legal).
4) Contingency: documented fallback to smaller-model path with explicit quality/regression notes (owner: Soojin / Research).
5) Weekly cadence: 15-minute Monday readouts starting Oct 12 (owner: Naomi).

I'll update the QBR pack with these bullets and include the attached one-pager and runbook links. If there are no objections, we'll mark this as the recommended mid-cycle course correction and present it in Thursday's leadership sync.

Best,
Soojin
Senior PM, Platform
Redwood Inference
